newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Economists pick NZ core inflation at 2.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Economists pick NZ core inflation at 2.38 pct.

text.p: A group of five bank economists polled by Reuters estimated underlying inflation in the year to December 1996 would be 2.38 percent.
They based their estimate on figures released on friday showing the Consumer price Index rose 0.7 percent in the December quarter and 2.6 percent in the December year.
The Reserve Bank was due to release its measure of underlying inflation later this morning.
Two of the economists said their forecasts assumed that fuel prices were included in the Reserve Bank's calculations.
